code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    if len(markers) < 2:
        return out
    def has_neighbor(r, c):
        return any(0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w and grid[r + dr][c + dc] not in (0, 5)
                   for dr in (-1, 0, 1) for dc in (-1, 0, 1) if dr or dc)
    source = next((p for p in markers if has_neighbor(*p)), markers[0])
    target = next((p for p in markers if p != source), markers[1])
    dr, dc = target[0] - source[0], target[1] - source[1]
    out[target[0]][target[1]] = 0
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color and (r, c) != source and (r, c) != target:
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
